title: Improsperous

inlines.v: IMPROS'PEROUS, adjective [in and prosperous.] Not prosperous; not successful; unfortunate; not yielding profit; not advancing interest; as an improsperous undertaking or voyage. [Unprosperous is the word most generally used in the sense.]
